 What to Stream 13 New K-Drama OTT Releases This Week (Nov 9-15): Happy Anding, Sword & Silence, Love in Disguise To Summer Vacation 
 We have 13 K-drama releases lined up for the week of November 9-15, 2026, and there is plenty to add to your watchlist. We start with the premieres of Happy Anding and Sword & Silence, followed by Love in Disguise, Summer Vacation, Between Steps, kiDnap GAME, The Remarried Empress, Merry Berry Love, Doctor X: Mafia in White, The Perfect Lie, 100 Days of Deception, Final Table and Oh! My Guard. These Korean dramas bring a mix of historical intrigue, romance, suspense, medical drama and comedy to platforms including Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Viu, Viki and more. The K-drama releases this week, November 9-15, include Happy Anding, Sword & Silence, Love in Disguise, Summer Vacation, Between Steps, kiDnap GAME, The Remarried Empress, Merry Berry Love, Doctor X: Mafia in White, The Perfect Lie, 100 Days of Deception, Final Table and Oh! My Guard. The lineup brings palace intrigue, romance, mystery, medical drama, comedy and culinary competition to streaming platforms such as Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Viu and Viki.  Korean dramas have a way of turning small, ordinary feelings into stories you can’t stop thinking about, and this week is a fine example. A palace betrayal, a detective in disguise, a kidnapping game across seven cities. Well, K-dramas never do things halfway. The K-drama releases this week (Nov 9-15) bring two premieres, Happy Anding and Sword & Silence, plus eleven returning series: Love in Disguise, Summer Vacation, Between Steps, kiDnap GAME, The Remarried Empress, Merry Berry Love, Doctor X: Mafia in White, The Perfect Lie, 100 Days of Deception, Final Table and Oh! My Guard. Check out all 13 titles below, premieres first, then the returning shows by release date.
 New K-Drama OTT Releases This Week (Nov 9-15)
 Happy Anding (tvN / TVING): November 11
 Kang Hoon, Cho Hyun-chul and Kim Jung-jin play comedians ten years in and still waiting for a break, until a fan prompts them to rethink their careers.
 Sword & Silence (KBS2 / Wavve): November 14
 KBS2’s historical drama follows the prince destined to become King Munmu, as war and betrayal test his dream of unifying the peninsula. Jang Hyuk co-stars.
 Love in Disguise (Prime Video): November 9 and 10
 Episodes 7 and 8 find undercover detective Kang Jae-hee watching chaebol heir Yoon Yi-jun, a murder suspect, while their bond complicates her mission.
 Summer Vacation (Viki): November 9 and 10
 Episodes 5 and 6 follow 18-year-old Kim Ha-yeon, whose summer in Upo Village turns mysterious after she meets landowner’s son Jo Yu-gyeom.
 Between Steps (Disney+): November 9 and 10
 Episodes 11 and 12 follow Choo Young-woo’s former swimmer and Kim So-hyun’s graduate student, whose robotics-lab romance tests ambition and trust.
 kiDnap GAME (Disney+ / Viu): November 10
 Episode 6 of Lee Joon Gi and Sakaguchi Kentaro’s thriller, where seven struggling people must survive a deadly game after kidnappings in seven cities.
 The Remarried Empress (Disney+): November 11
 Episodes 5 and 6 follow Shin Min-ah’s Navier after Emperor Sovieshu breaks his promise, while Lee Jong-suk’s Heinrey, a spy, falls for her.
 Merry Berry Love (Disney+): November 11
 Episode 6 finds Ji Chang-wook’s spatial designer and Imada Mio’s strawberry farmer healing each other on a remote Japanese island.
 Doctor X: Mafia in White (Netflix): November 13 and 14
 Kim Ji-won plays fearless surgeon Kye Su-jeong, who confronts corruption inside a powerful university hospital in episodes 11 and 12.
 The Perfect Lie (Disney+): November 13 and 14
 Yoo Yeon-seok and Seo Hyun-jin play a surgeon and a librarian with clashing memories of one event, in episodes 5 and 6.
 100 Days of Deception (Netflix): November 14 and 15
 Episodes 11 and 12 of this 1932 Gyeongseong spy romance, starring Kim Yoo-jung and Park Jin-young, tangle a pickpocket-turned-agent with an interpreter.
 Final Table (Prime Video): November 14 and 15
 Ahn Hyo-seop returns to K-dramas as chef Kang Han, who enters a high-stakes contest to name South Korea’s top chef in episodes 7 and 8.
 Oh! My Guard (Viu): November 14 and 15
 Episodes 7 and 8 pair actor Uhm Tae-bong with the mysterious Oh Hae-ra, in a romantic comedy about public image meeting private life.
